text:
Maya R.: FYI VoltCompute sent their forecast and pricing matrix for H1. They highlighted reserved caps per-customer and a recommended spot floor. Need to translate into our marketplace SKU lanes.

Diego S.: Do we have the vendor spreadsheet? paste link pls.

Lina Q.: Uploaded: https://rwd-infer/drive/volt-h1-pricing.xlsx - quick callouts: per-node pricing, but they included gpu_count so I converted to per-GPU. Regions: us-east-1, eu-central-1, ap-south-1.

Omar H.: What are the reserve tenors and discounts?

Lina Q.: Tenors: 1mo/3mo/12mo. Discounts: 1mo=0%, 3mo=7%, 12mo=20%. Spot guidelines: floor = base * 0.30-0.50. They recommend a spot cap per-account to avoid noisy neighbors.

Maya R.: VoltCompute also offered a co-marketing credit: up to 10% of first-month reserved spend if we do a joint launch webinar + featured listing. Put a cofund flag in the model.

Jules P.: Note marketplace revenue share is 12% for this partner (negotiated), not our default 10%. That affects net unit economics materially.

Diego S.: Sample data they sent (per-gpu):
```
region,node_type,gpu_count,base_hourly_usd,reserved_pct,spot_pct,max_per_customer
us-east-1,vc-32,8,3.10,65,30,40
eu-central-1,vc-64,16,5.90,55,35,20
ap-south-1,vc-16,4,2.20,40,35,10
```

Omar H.: For modeling, assume usable_spot = spot_pct * 0.8 (preempt churn). Also apply 6% ops-safety haircut on reserved availability for maintenance.

Lina Q.: I'll add columns: cofund_promo, marketplace_share, sla_eligible, lead_time_days. VoltCompute flagged lead_time: 7-30 days depending on SKU.

Maya R.: SLA: they can support SLA-backed reserved pools in us-east-1 & eu-central-1 (99.9). Spot pools are best-effort across the board. Mark SLA eligibility accordingly.

Jules P.: Finance question: what's the payment term? Net-30? Any invoice discounts?

Lina Q.: Payment terms: net-30. They offered an early-pay 1.5% rebate if we pay within 10 days for reserved blocks > $250k/mo. I'll add a boolean early_pay_rebate flag.

Finance Bot: Reminder: include tax and marketplace commission when computing net payback period.

Diego S.: For pricing engineering, can we map per-GPU hourly to our token cost baseline for the Llama2-medium mix? Use serving baseline: 1 GPU -> 0.00095 USD/token (for our 6k avg context mix).

Maya R.: Also capture cap per-customer and regional limits so marketplace UI can disable large single-customer purchases. Add max_per_customer to the SKU metadata.

Omar H.: Sensitivity request: show net_unit_cost for mixes: 70% reserved/30% spot, 50/50, and 30/70. Also show effect of cofund promo on first-month CAC.

Lina Q.: Will add sensitivity sheet with reserved_pct, spot_pct, effective_spot_usability, marketplace_share, cofund_credit_usd, net_unit_cost_usd.

Jules P.: Timeline: can you get a completed sheet + short summary in this thread by EOD? We'll schedule a 20-min sync w/ pricing and product tomorrow to lock SKU lanes.

Lina Q.: Yes - pushing final sheet by 17:30 PT and will paste the top-line numbers here.

Maya R.: Thanks all. After Lina posts, I'll coordinate with marketing for the joint webinar ask. Marketplace Bot: create draft SKU with seller=voltcompute, sku-draft=vc-h1-1

Marketplace Bot: Draft SKU created (vc-h1-1). Required metadata: unit_price, sla_tag, cofund_flag, max_per_customer.

Finance Bot: Also ensure we include the early-pay rebate scenario in our cashflow table for ARR modeling.

Diego S.: Great - once Lina posts I'll run the sensitivity and ping pricing-eng.

Maya R.: Closing loop: objective is to have marketplace-ready SKU rows (on-demand, commit-3mo, commit-12mo, spot-saver) and a 1-paragraph recommendation for pricing tiering by EOD tomorrow. Appreciate the turnaround.
